steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A breadboard provides a solderless prototyping platform with internal spring contacts connecting rows and columns. | Key Fact: Breadboard connections are temporary and suitable for testing circuit designs before permanent construction. | Key Fact: Stripboard (Veroboard) has copper tracks in rows; tracks must be cut to isolate sections where connections are not wanted. | Key Fact: PCB design involves creating a layout with copper tracks that connect component pads according to the circuit schematic.
